title: Island, British Pavilion: Rooftop plan (captioned on sheet 'Deck plan 1:200')
contents: Deck (rooftop) plan of the 2018 scaffold platform over the British Pavilion, the pavilion roof tip shown in the centre opening, external stair and lift on the east side; surrounding Giardini trees, paths and neighbouring building outlines (lower left) drawn as site context. Label 'Deck plan 1:200' at the foot of the sheet.
scale: 1:200 (as printed on the original sheet; raster export, scale not valid for the jpg)
author: Caruso St John Architects with Marcus Taylor

title: Island, British Pavilion: East elevation 1:100

title: Island, British Pavilion: North elevation (main facade) 1:100
